pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

comment.comment:
The time has come for me to finally be honest with myself.

The house always wins. And so do the insiders.

I haven’t met any kind people reaching out to me on X (@BenaTrades4MIO) who genuinely wanted to help me. And that’s okay. I don’t expect anyone to. I completely understand that everyone is looking out for themselves in this market.

But I have to face the truth.

I have never been able to beat these intelligent, experienced traders. They’re simply too smart, too experienced, and too far ahead of people like me.

People always say:

“If you can’t hold, you can’t get rich.”

But here’s something nobody tells you:

“If you can’t hold, you can’t lose $50,000 either. Just like I did.”

I held every position. I believed in the narratives. I believed in the communities. I believed that patience would eventually pay off.

Instead, I became exit liquidity. Again and again and again.

And now, enough is enough.

My girlfriend is going to kill me when she finds out how bad things have gotten. I’m genuinely struggling financially right now, and I’ve dug myself into some pretty deep holes.

I’m going to let my remaining positions ride, even if they go all the way to zero. But after that, I’m done.

No more chasing dreams. No more being someone else’s exit liquidity. No more convincing myself that the next trade will change my life.

To every trader out there still chasing their dream, I genuinely wish you all the luck in the world.

I hope you make it. I hope you find that life-changing trade. I hope you achieve the financial freedom you’re fighting for.

And most importantly, I hope you never end up being used as exit liquidity the way I was.

I wanted to change my life.

Instead, I learned a $50,000 lesson.

Take care of yourselves out there. ❤️

But at least, every once in a while, I got to dream a little about that one big win that could have changed my life. And for those moments, the dream felt real. ❤️
